proposals.logic_code: pub fn score_bin (item_size : u32 , bin_residual : u32 , bin_capacity : u32 , step_index : usize , total_items : usize , open_bins_count : usize , mean_residual : f64 , next_item_size : u32 , post_residual : u32 , fitting_bins_count : usize) -> f64 { let cap = bin_capacity as f64 ; let post = post_residual as f64 ; let mut score = post ; if post_residual == 0 { score -= 1000.0 ; } if next_item_size > 0 { if post_residual == next_item_size { score -= 900.0 ; } else if post_residual > next_item_size { let slack = (post_residual - next_item_size) as f64 ; let chain = 220.0 * (1.0 - slack / cap) ; if slack > 0.0 && slack < 12.0 { score -= chain - 80.0 - 4.0 * (12.0 - slack) ; } else { score -= chain ; } } else { let excess = (post - mean_residual) . max (0.0) ; score += 55.0 + 0.7 * excess + 0.25 * (post / cap) ; } } let progress = step_index as f64 / total_items . max (1) as f64 ; if bin_residual != bin_capacity { score -= 110.0 * progress ; let fill_ratio = 1.0 - (bin_residual as f64) / cap ; score -= 80.0 * fill_ratio * fill_ratio * progress ; if next_item_size > post_residual && post_residual > 0 { score += 15.0 ; } } else { let crowding = 1.0 / (fitting_bins_count . max (1) as f64) ; score += 260.0 * progress + 0.5 * mean_residual + 190.0 * crowding ; score -= 160.0 * (1.0 - progress) * (1.0 - crowding) ; if next_item_size as f64 > 0.6 * cap { score -= 40.0 ; } } score }

pub fn score_bin (item_size : u32 , bin_residual : u32 , bin_capacity : u32 , step_index : usize , total_items : usize , open_bins_count : usize , mean_residual : f64 , next_item_size : u32 , post_residual : u32 , fitting_bins_count : usize) -> f64 { let cap = bin_capacity as f64 ; let post = post_residual as f64 ; let mut score = post ; if post_residual == 0 { score -= 1000.0 ; } if next_item_size > 0 { if post_residual == next_item_size { score -= 950.0 ; } else if post_residual > next_item_size { let slack = (post_residual - next_item_size) as f64 ; let chain = 240.0 * (1.0 - slack / cap) ; if slack > 0.0 && slack < 14.0 { score -= chain - 85.0 - 4.0 * (14.0 - slack) ; } else { score -= chain ; } } else { let excess = (post - mean_residual) . max (0.0) ; score += 60.0 + 0.75 * excess + 0.3 * (post / cap) + 0.15 * (next_item_size as f64) ; } } let progress = step_index as f64 / total_items . max (1) as f64 ; if bin_residual != bin_capacity { score -= 115.0 * progress ; let fill_ratio = 1.0 - (bin_residual as f64) / cap ; score -= 85.0 * fill_ratio * fill_ratio * progress ; if next_item_size > post_residual && post_residual > 0 { score += 18.0 - 10.0 * progress ; } } else { let crowding = 1.0 / (fitting_bins_count . max (1) as f64) ; score += 270.0 * progress + 0.55 * mean_residual + 200.0 * crowding ; score -= 165.0 * (1.0 - progress) * (1.0 - crowding) ; if next_item_size as f64 > 0.6 * cap { score -= 45.0 ; } if fitting_bins_count <= 1 { score += 30.0 * (1.0 - progress) ; } } score }

pub fn score_bin (item_size : u32 , bin_residual : u32 , bin_capacity : u32 , step_index : usize , total_items : usize , open_bins_count : usize , mean_residual : f64 , next_item_size : u32 , post_residual : u32 , fitting_bins_count : usize) -> f64 { let cap = bin_capacity as f64 ; let post = post_residual as f64 ; let mut score = post ; if post_residual == 0 { score -= 1000.0 ; } if next_item_size > 0 { if post_residual == next_item_size { score -= 900.0 ; } else if post_residual > next_item_size { let slack = (post_residual - next_item_size) as f64 ; let chain = 220.0 * (1.0 - slack / cap) ; if slack > 0.0 && slack < 14.0 { score -= chain - 80.0 - 4.0 * (14.0 - slack) ; } else { score -= chain ; } } else { let excess = (post - mean_residual) . max (0.0) ; score += 55.0 + 0.7 * excess + 0.25 * (post / cap) ; } } let progress = step_index as f64 / total_items . max (1) as f64 ; if bin_residual != bin_capacity { score -= 110.0 * progress ; let fill_ratio = 1.0 - (bin_residual as f64) / cap ; score -= 80.0 * fill_ratio * fill_ratio * progress ; if next_item_size > post_residual && post_residual > 0 { score += 15.0 ; } // penalize dead space more aggressively late in the stream
 if post_residual > 0 && (next_item_size as f64) > post as f64 { let dead = post / cap ; score += 45.0 * dead * progress + 35.0 * dead * dead * progress ; } // reward bins whose residual stays divisible-friendly: small residuals are likely future-exact fits
 if post_residual > 0 && post_residual <= 20 { score -= 60.0 * (1.0 - post as f64 / 20.0) * progress ; } // penalize medium residuals that are neither exact-fit candidates nor near-full
 let mid = post / cap ; if post > 20.0 && post < 0.5 * cap { score += 18.0 * mid * progress ; } } else { let crowding = 1.0 / (fitting_bins_count . max (1) as f64) ; score += 260.0 * progress + 0.5 * mean_residual + 190.0 * crowding ; score -= 160.0 * (1.0 - progress) * (1.0 - crowding) ; if next_item_size as f64 > 0.6 * cap { score -= 40.0 ; } if fitting_bins_count <= 1 { score -= 25.0 * (1.0 - progress) ; } // late-stream: opening fresh bins is cheaper than fragmenting crowded ones
 if progress > 0.75 { score += 30.0 * progress ; } } score }
